stem:
The dot plot shows the results of a survey where people were asked the number of trips they had taken to a movie theater in the last year.

Movie Theater Survey

Each ● means 1 person.

Which statement best describes the data represented in the dot plot?

options.label: A
options.text: A total of 10 people responded to the survey.

options.label: B
options.text: There were 8 people who took 2 or fewer trips to a movie theater.

options.label: C
options.text: All the people who responded to the survey took at least 1 trip to a movie theater.

options.label: D
options.text: Half the people who responded to the survey took 5 or more trips to a movie theater.

visual_elements: dot plot with values: 0(3 dots), 1(2 dots), 2(3 dots), 3(1 dot), 4(3 dots), 5(4 dots), 8(1 dot), 10(1 dot)
